reason: I already tried background agents and the PRs were not worth reviewing. A pre-alpha tool from one developer, with no case studies, does not give me a reason to try again.
objection: Running it overnight does not make the PRs better. I would wake up to more mediocre PRs to review across my client projects, and the project could die if the one developer stops.
would_change_my_mind: Case studies from teams like mine that show the overnight PRs got merged without big rework, plus real GitHub traction.
